verdict.rationale: Marqeta documents an official Marqeta MCP Server that lets your own AI agents interact with its payment platform. The listed capabilities are virtual card issuance, spend controls and transaction querying, and a probe confirms the dedicated developer guide exists. missing for 10: connection/setup and authentication details for the server, independent or hands-on corroboration, and clarity on coverage beyond the 'designated set' of Core API endpoints.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Use the Marqeta MCP Server with your own AI agents to query data from a designated set of Marqeta's Core API endpoints.
The Marqeta Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows your AI agents to interact seamlessly with Marqeta's payment platform using natural language processing (NLP).
